responsibility: This header exposes the small public interface of the OpenMP expansion stage to the rest of the middle end. It forward-declares the omp_region abstraction and declares helpers used during CFG construction and cleanup—most notably local OpenMP expansion entry points, region disposal, and omp_make_gimple_edges for creating CFG edges around GIMPLE_OMP markers before full expansion.
same_name_distinction: Declares only the narrow cross-file interface to the expansion machinery—forward declaration of omp_region plus entry points such as omp_expand_local, omp_free_regions, and omp_make_gimple_edges. Unlike gcc/omp-expand.cc, it does not implement region expansion or own the internal omp_region logic.
